extra_quotes: Spin pumping combined with inverse spin Hall effect (ISHE) in a strongly spin -orbit-coupled (SOC) metal like Pt provides a convenient means of investigating spin transmission across insulating layers.

Thin-film heterostructures of the type (0001) Al2O3/Pt (10 nm)/α-Fe2O3(x nm)/Py (30 nm), with x = 30, 40 and 100 nm were deposited using a load -lock, multi-target high-vacuum magnetron sputtering system with a base pressure of 8 x 10-9 Torr.
FMR measurements were performed using a custom -built broadband Cryo-FMR spectrometer operated in frequency-modulation mode from 1.6 to 300 K 25.
